1. Find the largest Sobel gradient of luma in the image, Gmax, once.
2. Snap the first click to the strongest edge within the width setting.
3. As the pointer moves, snap it to the strongest edge within the width.
4. Find the cheapest 8-connected path from the last anchor, where steps on strong edges are cheap.
5. Fix an anchor when the path gets longer than the anchor spacing, or when you click.
6. On closing, find a path back to the start that does not reuse the path so far.
7. Fill the closed path as a polygon and combine it with the selection by the mode.
